Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer surfaced and relayed contradictory snippet data indicating Jake Scott’s father was Tony Scott and did not flag or reconcile this conflict with earlier credible indications (Ridley Scott). This overreliance on search-engine snippets, coupled with repeated, non-convergent queries instead of consulting authoritative sources directly (e.g., opening the BBC article), introduced unresolved contradiction about the father’s identity and risked leading to an incorrect conclusion.
